about: The checks every project has (R142): what a person would put right (design sense, S) and what the typology asks of a room (T). Notes only, never refusals. A template's own checks (its "checks") replace one here by id, add new ones, or take one out with off: true; a project's overrides.checks the same; a firm's own copy of this file wins in its work. Each rule: of (room, pair, thing, blocking, ratio), when (a formula: true says the note), say (the note; {name} from the facts, {= formula} worked out), zone (blocking: how far either side of the wall's line an opening needs clear, mm). The facts each kind has are listed in the app's managers/projects/checks.js.

checks.say: {room} has no door: nobody can get into it.
{room} is {side} mm across at its narrowest: under {roomSide} mm is too narrow to use.
{room} is {area} m²: under {roomArea} m² is too small to use.
{thing} stands in the wall {wall}: {wall_depth} mm into it.
{thing} stands in the way of the {is} {opening}.
{thing} stands in front of the window {opening} and is taller than its sill.
{room} has no use yet: say what it is used as ({= guess != '' ? 'a ' + guess + '?' : examples}).
{room} is used as {use}, which is not one of this model's uses ({typology_name}: {use_list}…).

checks.when: known_use && side >= roomSide && area >= roomArea && use_minSide > 0 && side < use_minSide
checks.say: {room} is {side} mm across at its narrowest; a {use_label} is at least {use_minSide} mm {typology}.

checks.when: known_use && side >= roomSide && area >= roomArea && !(use_minSide > 0 && side < use_minSide) && use_minArea > 0 && area < use_minArea
checks.say: {room} is {area} m²; a {use_label} is at least {use_minArea} m² {typology}.
{room} has no window to the outside; a {use_label} needs one {typology}.
{a} opens straight into {b}: a {a_use_label} and a {b_use_label} are kept apart {typology}.

checks.when: known_use && by_furniture && use_unitArea > 0 && each_area < use_unitArea * packed
checks.say: {room} holds {holds} {unit_plural} in {room_area} m²: {each_area} m² each, where about {use_unitArea} m² is usual {typology}.
